package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

// AnswerHandler handles student and reviewer endpoints.
type AnswerHandler struct {
	Validator   *validator.Validate
	Start       answer.StartTaskAnswer
	Progress    *answer.ProgressionService
	Submit      answer.SubmitTaskAnswer
	SubmitById  answer.FinalValidation
	List        answer.ListStudentAnswers
	Get         answer.GetStudentAnswer
	ListResults answer.ListStudentResults
	GetResult   answer.GetStudentResult
	Manual      answer.ApplyManualReview
}

// SubmitRequest body.
type SubmitRequest struct {
	StudentTaskAnswerID string `json:"student_task_answer_id" validate:"required,uuid4"`
	FilestorageID       string `json:"filestorage_id" validate:"required,uuid4"`
}

// ManualReviewRequest body.
type ManualReviewRequest struct {
	Status     int      `json:"status" validate:"required,oneof=3 5"`
	FinalScore *float64 `json:"final_score" validate:"omitempty"`
	Feedback   *string  `json:"feedback" validate:"omitempty"`
}

type startTaskResponse struct {
	AnswerID               string `json:"answer_id"`
	LearningActionID       string `json:"learning_action_id"`
	SandboxID              string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	Status                 string `json:"status"`
	PreviewURL             string `json:"preview_url"`
	Type                   int16  `json:"type"`
	TaskKind               string `json:"task_kind"`
	ExecutionMode          string `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool   `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool   `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool   `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool   `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	TerminalWSURL          string `json:"terminal_ws_url,omitempty"`
}

type taskLockedResponse struct {
	Code             string `json:"code"`
	Message          string `json:"message"`
	RedirectLessonID string `json:"redirect_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RedirectTaskID   string `json:"redirect_task_id,omitempty"`
}

type submitByIDRequest struct {
	AnswerPayload json.RawMessage `json:"answer_payload"`
}

type wikiReviewResponse struct {
	Passed  bool  `json:"passed"`
	Errors  []any `json:"errors"`
	Score   int   `json:"score"`
	Details any   `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

type wikiSubmitResponse struct {
	AnswerID string             `json:"answer_id"`
	Status   string             `json:"status"`
	Review   wikiReviewResponse `json:"review"`
}

type wikiGetAnswerResponse struct {
	AnswerID    string             `json:"answer_id"`
	Status      string             `json:"status"`
	StartedAt   time.Time          `json:"started_at"`
	SubmittedAt *time.Time         `json:"submitted_at,omitempty"`
	Review      wikiReviewResponse `json:"review"`
}

// StartTask starts new attempt.
func (h AnswerHandler) StartTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	var input struct {
		LearningPathItemID string `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
		RequirementID      string `json:"requirement_id"`
	}
	if r.Body != nil {
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 4097))
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil && err != io.EOF {
			writeDomainError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
			return
		}
		if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
			writeDomainError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
			return
		}
	}
	out, err := h.Start.Handle(requestContext, answer.StartTaskAnswerInput{StudentID: userID, TaskID: taskID, LearningPathItemID: input.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: input.RequirementID})
	if err != nil {
		var lockedErr *answer.TaskLockedError
		if errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusConflict, taskLockedResponse{
				Code:             "TASK_LOCKED",
				Message:          lockedErr.Error(),
				RedirectLessonID: lockedErr.RedirectLessonID,
				RedirectTaskID:   lockedErr.RedirectTaskID,
			})
			return
		}
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, startTaskResponse{
		AnswerID:               out.AnswerID,
		LearningActionID:       out.LearningActionID,
		SandboxID:              out.SandboxID,
		Status:                 out.Status,
		PreviewURL:             out.PreviewURL,
		Type:                   out.Type,
		TaskKind:               out.TaskKind,
		ExecutionMode:          out.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         out.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 out.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         out.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        out.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         out.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        out.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: out.SupportsLiveValidation,
		TerminalWSURL:          out.TerminalWSURL,
	})
}

// GetCourseProgression returns ordered lessons/tasks with lock state for current user.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetCourseProgression(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(w, "progression is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	result, err := h.Progress.ResolveCourse(requestContext, userID, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

// GetTaskAccess returns access state for one task for current user.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetTaskAccess(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(w, "progression is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	result, err := h.Progress.ResolveTaskAccess(requestContext, userID, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

// GetLessonAccess returns access state for one lesson for current user.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetLessonAccess(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(w, "progression is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	result, err := h.Progress.ResolveLessonAccess(requestContext, userID, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

// GetLesson returns lesson details only when lesson access is allowed.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetLesson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.Progress == nil || h.Progress.Lessons == nil {
		http.Error(w, "lesson provider is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	access, err := h.Progress.ResolveLessonAccess(requestContext, userID, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if access.Locked {
		writeLessonLocked(w, access)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.Progress.Lessons.GetLesson(requestContext, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, buildStudentLessonResponse(item))
}

// GetTask returns task details only when task access is allowed.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.Progress == nil || h.Progress.TaskProvider == nil {
		http.Error(w, "task provider is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	access, err := h.Progress.ResolveTaskAccess(requestContext, userID, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if access.Locked {
		writeTaskLocked(w, access)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.Progress.TaskProvider.GetTask(answer.WithTaskLookupContext(requestContext, userID, ""), taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, buildStudentTaskResponse(answer.NormalizeTaskMetadata(item)))
}

// GetAnswerById returns answer details for task (wiki-compatible).
func (h AnswerHandler) GetAnswerById(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}

	details, err := h.Get.Handle(r.Context(), answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if details.Answer.StudentID != userID || details.Answer.TaskID != taskID {
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wikiGetAnswerResponse{
		AnswerID:    details.Answer.ID,
		Status:      statusToWiki(details.Answer.Status),
		StartedAt:   details.Answer.StartedAt,
		SubmittedAt: details.Answer.EndedAt,
		Review:      buildWikiReview(details.Answer.Status, details.AutoReview, requestLocale(r)),
	})
}

// SubmitTask submits attempt for review.
func (h AnswerHandler) SubmitTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	var req SubmitRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	ans, err := h.Submit.Handle(requestContext, answer.SubmitTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID:           userID,
		TaskID:              taskID,
		StudentTaskAnswerID: req.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		FilestorageID:       req.FilestorageID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, buildStudentAnswerResponse(*ans, nil, nil))
}

// SubmitAnswerById submits answer by ID for final validation.
func (h AnswerHandler) SubmitAnswerById(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	requestContext, err := publicContentContext(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}

	// Verify ownership
	details, err := h.Get.Handle(requestContext, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if details.Answer.StudentID != userID || details.Answer.TaskID != taskID {
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}

	var req submitByIDRequest
	if r.Body != nil {
		_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)
	}

	// Execute final validation
	err = h.SubmitById.Handle(requestContext, answerID, req.AnswerPayload)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}

	// Return updated answer
	updated, err := h.Get.Handle(requestContext, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wikiSubmitResponse{
		AnswerID: updated.Answer.ID,
		Status:   statusToWiki(updated.Answer.Status),
		Review:   buildWikiReview(updated.Answer.Status, updated.AutoReview, requestLocale(r)),
	})
}

// ListMyAnswers returns attempts for current user and task.
func (h AnswerHandler) ListMyAnswers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	answers, err := h.List.Handle(r.Context(), taskID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	resp := make([]answerResponse, 0, len(answers))
	for _, a := range answers {
		resp = append(resp, buildStudentAnswerResponse(a, nil, nil))
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// GetMyAnswer returns attempt details.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetMyAnswer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	details, err := h.Get.Handle(r.Context(), answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if details.Answer.StudentID != userID {
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, buildStudentAnswerResponse(details.Answer, details.AutoReview, details.ManualReview))
}

// ListMyResults returns attempts across all tasks for current user.
func (h AnswerHandler) ListMyResults(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.ListResults.Answers == nil {
		http.Error(w, "results are not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	limit := 20
	offset := 0
	if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); raw != "" {
		if parsed, err := strconv.Atoi(raw); err == nil {
			limit = parsed
		}
	}
	if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); raw != "" {
		if parsed, err := strconv.Atoi(raw); err == nil {
			offset = parsed
		}
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 20
	}
	if limit > 200 {
		limit = 200
	}
	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}

	resultPage, err := h.ListResults.Handle(r.Context(), userID, answer.ListStudentResultsInput{
		TaskID: strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("task_id")),
		Limit:  limit,
		Offset: offset,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}

	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(resultPage.Items))
	for _, item := range resultPage.Items {
		payload := map[string]any{
			"id":             item.Answer.ID,
			"task_id":        item.Answer.TaskID,
			"status":         item.Answer.Status,
			"attempt":        item.Answer.Attempt,
			"started_at":     item.Answer.StartedAt,
			"ended_at":       item.Answer.EndedAt,
			"filestorage_id": item.Answer.FilestorageID,
			"created_at":     item.Answer.CreatedAt,
		}
		if item.SandboxID != "" {
			payload["sandbox_id"] = item.SandboxID
		}
		if item.Task != nil {
			payload["task"] = map[string]any{
				"id":          item.Task.ID,
				"lesson_id":   item.Task.LessonID,
				"course_id":   item.Task.CourseID,
				"title":       item.Task.Title,
				"description": item.Task.Description,
			}
		}
		items = append(items, payload)
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"items":  items,
		"limit":  resultPage.Limit,
		"offset": resultPage.Offset,
		"total":  resultPage.Total,
	})
}

// GetMyResult returns detailed result payload for one answer.
func (h AnswerHandler) GetMyResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	userID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if h.GetResult.GetAnswer.Answers == nil {
		http.Error(w, "result details are not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	result, err := h.GetResult.Handle(r.Context(), userID, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrForbidden {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}

	var taskPayload any
	if result.Task != nil {
		taskPayload = map[string]any{
			"id":           result.Task.ID,
			"lesson_id":    result.Task.LessonID,
			"course_id":    result.Task.CourseID,
			"title":        result.Task.Title,
			"description":  result.Task.Description,
			"max_attempts": result.Task.MaxAttempts,
		}
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"answer":            buildStudentAnswerResponse(result.Details.Answer, result.Details.AutoReview, result.Details.ManualReview),
		"task":              taskPayload,
		"attempts_for_task": result.AttemptsForTask,
		"sandbox_id":        result.SandboxID,
	})
}

// ManualReview handles reviewer decision.
func (h AnswerHandler) ManualReview(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	var req ManualReviewRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	reviewerID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	_, err := h.Manual.Handle(r.Context(), answer.ApplyManualReviewInput{
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
		ReviewerID:          reviewerID,
		Status:              req.Status,
		FinalScore:          req.FinalScore,
		Feedback:            req.Feedback,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	details, err := h.Get.Handle(r.Context(), answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, buildAnswerResponse(details.Answer, details.AutoReview, details.ManualReview))
}

func buildAnswerResponse(ans domain.StudentTaskAnswer, auto *domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, manual *domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview) answerResponse {
	resp := answerResponse{
		ID:            ans.ID,
		StudentID:     ans.StudentID,
		TaskID:        ans.TaskID,
		FilestorageID: ans.FilestorageID,
		AnswerPayload: ans.AnswerPayload,
		StartedAt:     ans.StartedAt,
		EndedAt:       ans.EndedAt,
		Status:        ans.Status,
		Attempt:       ans.Attempt,
		CreatedAt:     ans.CreatedAt,
		UpdatedAt:     ans.UpdatedAt,
	}
	if auto != nil {
		resp.AutoReview = &autoReviewResponse{
			ValidatorName: auto.ValidatorName,
			AutoScore:     auto.AutoScore,
			Passed:        auto.Passed,
			Feedback:      auto.Feedback,
			CheckedAt:     auto.CheckedAt,
			RawResult:     auto.RawResult,
		}
	}
	if manual != nil {
		resp.ManualReview = &manualReviewResponse{
			ReviewerID: manual.ReviewerID,
			CheckedAt:  manual.CheckedAt,
			FinalScore: manual.FinalScore,
			Status:     manual.Status,
			Feedback:   manual.Feedback,
		}
	}
	return resp
}

func buildStudentAnswerResponse(ans domain.StudentTaskAnswer, auto *domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, manual *domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview) answerResponse {
	resp := buildAnswerResponse(ans, auto, manual)
	if resp.AutoReview != nil && auto != nil {
		resp.AutoReview.RawResult = safeStudentReviewRawResult(auto.RawResult, auto.Passed)
		if isTaskTestRawResult(auto.RawResult) {
			resp.AutoReview.Feedback = nil
		}
	}
	return resp
}

func statusToWiki(status int) string {
	switch status {
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress:
		return "IN_PROCESS"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview:
		return "UNDER_REVIEW"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed:
		return "FAILED"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected:
		return "REJECTED"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed:
		return "PASSED"
	default:
		return "UNKNOWN"
	}
}

func buildWikiReview(status int, auto *domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, locale string) wikiReviewResponse {
	passed := status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed
	if auto != nil && status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
		passed = auto.Passed
	}
	score := 0
	if passed {
		score = 100
	}
	errors := []any{}
	var safeRawResult map[string]any
	if auto != nil {
		safeRawResult = safeStudentReviewRawResult(auto.RawResult, passed)
	}
	if !passed && safeRawResult != nil {
		if rawErrors, ok := safeRawResult["errors"]; ok {
			if arr, ok := rawErrors.([]any); ok {
				errors = localizeValidationErrors(arr, locale)
			}
		}
	}
	var details any
	if safeRawResult != nil {
		details = localizeReviewDetails(safeRawResult, locale)
	}
	return wikiReviewResponse{Passed: passed, Errors: errors, Score: score, Details: details}
}

func requestLocale(r *http.Request) string {
	if r == nil {
		return "en"
	}

	locale := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("X-Locale"))
	if locale == "" {
		locale = strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	}
	if locale == "" {
		return "en"
	}

	primary := strings.Split(locale, ",")[0]
	primary = strings.Split(primary, ";")[0]
	primary = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(primary))
	if strings.HasPrefix(primary, "ru") {
		return "ru"
	}
	return "en"
}

func localizeValidationErrors(errors []any, locale string) []any {
	if len(errors) == 0 || locale != "ru" {
		return errors
	}

	localized := make([]any, 0, len(errors))
	for _, item := range errors {
		record, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			localized = append(localized, item)
			continue
		}

		code := extractStringField(record, "Code", "code")
		message := extractStringField(record, "Message", "message")
		translated := translateValidationMessage(locale, code, message)
		if translated == "" || translated == message {
			localized = append(localized, item)
			continue
		}

		clone := make(map[string]any, len(record))
		for key, value := range record {
			clone[key] = value
		}
		if _, exists := clone["Message"]; exists {
			clone["Message"] = translated
		} else if _, exists := clone["message"]; exists {
			clone["message"] = translated
		} else {
			clone["Message"] = translated
		}
		localized = append(localized, clone)
	}

	return localized
}

func localizeReviewDetails(raw map[string]any, locale string) map[string]any {
	if raw == nil {
		return nil
	}
	clone := make(map[string]any, len(raw))
	for key, value := range raw {
		clone[key] = value
	}
	if locale != "ru" {
		return clone
	}

	items, ok := clone["items"].([]any)
	if !ok {
		return clone
	}
	localizedItems := make([]any, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		record, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			localizedItems = append(localizedItems, item)
			continue
		}
		copied := make(map[string]any, len(record))
		for key, value := range record {
			copied[key] = value
		}
		if value, exists := copied["correct"]; exists {
			if isCorrect, ok := value.(bool); ok {
				if isCorrect {
					copied["result_label"] = "Верно"
				} else {
					copied["result_label"] = "Неверно"
				}
			}
		}
		localizedItems = append(localizedItems, copied)
	}
	clone["items"] = localizedItems
	return clone
}

func extractStringField(record map[string]any, keys ...string) string {
	for _, key := range keys {
		value, ok := record[key]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		asString, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(asString)
		if trimmed != "" {
			return trimmed
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func translateValidationMessage(locale, code, message string) string {
	if locale != "ru" {
		return message
	}

	normalizedMessage := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(message))
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required string is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required string is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найдено обязательное содержимое: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найдено обязательное содержимое"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required variable is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required variable is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найдена обязательная переменная: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найдена обязательная переменная"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required interface is missing or incomplete:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required interface is missing or incomplete:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найден или некорректен обязательный интерфейс: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найден или некорректен обязательный интерфейс"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required function is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required function is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найдена обязательная функция: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найдена обязательная функция"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required method usage is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required method usage is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найдено обязательное использование метода: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найдено обязательное использование метода"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required route is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required route is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найден обязательный маршрут: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найден обязательный маршрут"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "source file is empty:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Source file is empty:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Исходный файл пуст: %s", details)
		}
		return "Исходный файл пуст"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "answer is missing for question:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Answer is missing for question:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Нет ответа на вопрос: %s", details)
		}
		return "Нет ответа на вопрос"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "selected answer does not belong to question:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Selected answer does not belong to question:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Выбранный вариант не относится к вопросу: %s", details)
		}
		return "Выбранный вариант не относится к вопросу"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "incorrect answer for question:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Incorrect answer for question:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Неверный ответ на вопрос: %s", details)
		}
		return "Неверный ответ на вопрос"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "incorrect order for question:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Incorrect order for question:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Указан неверный порядок элементов: %s", details)
		}
		return "Указан неверный порядок элементов"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "incorrect classification for question:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Incorrect classification for question:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Элементы распределены по неверным группам: %s", details)
		}
		return "Элементы распределены по неверным группам"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "too many incorrect answers:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Too many incorrect answers:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Слишком много неверных ответов: %s", details)
		}
		return "Слишком много неверных ответов"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required tag is missing:") {
		details := strings.TrimSpace(message[len("Required tag is missing:"):])
		if details != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("Не найден обязательный тег: %s", details)
		}
		return "Не найден обязательный тег"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required attribute is missing on <") {
		return strings.Replace(message, "Required attribute is missing on <", "Не найден обязательный атрибут у <", 1)
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required attribute has invalid value on <") {
		return strings.Replace(message, "Required attribute has invalid value on <", "Некорректное значение обязательного атрибута у <", 1)
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required child tag is missing inside <") {
		return strings.Replace(message, "Required child tag is missing inside <", "Не найден обязательный дочерний тег внутри <", 1)
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "required text is missing inside <") {
		return strings.Replace(message, "Required text is missing inside <", "Не найден обязательный текст внутри <", 1)
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(normalizedMessage, "tag <") && strings.Contains(normalizedMessage, "must contain at least") {
		remainder := strings.TrimSpace(message[strings.Index(normalizedMessage, "must contain at least")+len("must contain at least"):])
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s должен содержать как минимум %s", strings.TrimSpace(message[:strings.Index(message, "must contain at least")]), strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(remainder, "matching child elements")))
	}

	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(code)) {
	case "REQUIRED_FILE_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный файл"
	case "REQUIRED_STRING_MISSING":
		return "Не найдено обязательное содержимое"
	case "REQUIRED_VARIABLE_MISSING":
		return "Не найдена обязательная переменная"
	case "REQUIRED_INTERFACE_MISSING":
		return "Не найден или некорректен обязательный интерфейс"
	case "REQUIRED_FUNCTION_MISSING":
		return "Не найдена обязательная функция"
	case "REQUIRED_METHOD_MISSING":
		return "Не найдено обязательное использование метода"
	case "REQUIRED_ROUTE_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный маршрут"
	case "REQUIRED_DOCTYPE_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный doctype"
	case "REQUIRED_TAG_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный тег"
	case "REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный атрибут"
	case "REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_INVALID":
		return "У обязательного атрибута некорректное значение"
	case "REQUIRED_CHILD_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный дочерний тег"
	case "REQUIRED_TEXT_MISSING":
		return "Не найден обязательный текст"
	case "REQUIRED_MIN_CHILDREN":
		return "Недостаточно дочерних элементов"
	case "HTML_DOCUMENT_MISSING":
		return "HTML документ не найден"
	case "INVALID_CODE_STRUCTURE":
		return "Некорректная структура code_structure"
	case "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE":
		return "Валидатор недоступен"
	case "NO_WORKSPACE_FILES":
		return "Рабочая область пуста"
	case "NO_SOURCE_FILES":
		return "Исходные файлы не найдены"
	case "NO_SOURCE_FILE":
		return "Файл JavaScript или TypeScript не найден"
	case "EMPTY_SOURCE_FILE":
		return "Исходный файл пуст"
	case "NO_HTML_FILE":
		return "HTML файл не найден"
	case "NO_CSS_FILE":
		return "CSS файл не найден"
	case "NO_PHP_FILE":
		return "PHP файл не найден"
	case "NO_REACT_FILE":
		return "Файл React не найден"
	case "REACT_VALIDATION_ERROR":
		return "Ошибка валидации React"
	case "TEST_DEFINITION_MISSING":
		return "Тестовые вопросы не настроены"
	case "TEST_ANSWERS_INCOMPLETE":
		return "Нужно ответить на все вопросы теста"
	case "TEST_DUPLICATE_ANSWER":
		return "Для одного вопроса можно выбрать только один вариант"
	case "TEST_ANSWER_MISSING":
		return "Нужно ответить на вопрос теста"
	case "TEST_VARIANT_INVALID":
		return "Выбранный вариант ответа некорректен"
	case "TEST_VARIANT_INCORRECT":
		return "Выбран неверный вариант ответа"
	case "TEST_ORDER_INCORRECT":
		return "Указан неверный порядок элементов"
	case "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_INCORRECT":
		return "Элементы распределены по неверным группам"
	case "ASSESSMENT_INCORRECT":
		return "Ответ на задание неверен"
	case "TEST_ALLOWED_ERRORS_EXCEEDED":
		return "Количество ошибок превышает допустимый порог"
	}

	switch normalizedMessage {
	case "required file is missing":
		return "Не найден обязательный файл"
	case "required string is missing":
		return "Не найдено обязательное содержимое"
	case "invalid code_structure json":
		return "Некорректная структура code_structure"
	case "workspace is empty":
		return "Рабочая область пуста"
	case "no source files found":
		return "Исходные файлы не найдены"
	case "no javascript or typescript source file found":
		return "Файл JavaScript или TypeScript не найден"
	case "react validation error":
		return "Ошибка валидации React"
	case "no html file found":
		return "HTML файл не найден"
	case "no react source file found":
		return "Файл React не найден"
	case "test questions are not configured":
		return "Тестовые вопросы не настроены"
	case "answers for all test questions are required":
		return "Нужно ответить на все вопросы теста"
	case "only one answer per test question is allowed":
		return "Для одного вопроса можно выбрать только один вариант"
	}

	return message
}

type answerResponse struct {
	ID            string                `json:"id"`
	StudentID     string                `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID        string                `json:"task_id"`
	FilestorageID *string               `json:"filestorage_id,omitempty"`
	AnswerPayload json.RawMessage       `json:"answer_payload,omitempty"`
	StartedAt     time.Time             `json:"started_at"`
	EndedAt       *time.Time            `json:"ended_at,omitempty"`
	Status        int                   `json:"status"`
	Attempt       int                   `json:"attempt"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time             `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     time.Time             `json:"updated_at"`
	AutoReview    *autoReviewResponse   `json:"auto_review,omitempty"`
	ManualReview  *manualReviewResponse `json:"manual_review,omitempty"`
}

type autoReviewResponse struct {
	ValidatorName string         `json:"validator_name"`
	AutoScore     *float64       `json:"auto_score,omitempty"`
	Passed        bool           `json:"passed"`
	Feedback      *string        `json:"feedback,omitempty"`
	RawResult     map[string]any `json:"raw_result,omitempty"`
	CheckedAt     time.Time      `json:"checked_at"`
}

type manualReviewResponse struct {
	ReviewerID string    `json:"reviewer_id"`
	CheckedAt  time.Time `json:"checked_at"`
	FinalScore *float64  `json:"final_score,omitempty"`
	Status     int       `json:"status"`
	Feedback   *string   `json:"feedback,omitempty"`
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeDomainError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	var lockedErr *answer.TaskLockedError
	if errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusConflict, taskLockedResponse{
			Code:             "TASK_LOCKED",
			Message:          lockedErr.Error(),
			RedirectLessonID: lockedErr.RedirectLessonID,
			RedirectTaskID:   lockedErr.RedirectTaskID,
		})
		return
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusForbidden)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrSandboxNotFound):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrMaxAttempts), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrAnswerNotInProgress), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrAlreadyReviewed), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
	default:
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}
